Comment: Proposed Service Line workflow for observing a verified change after deployment. Read-only: it never rolls back, changes flags, or widens a rollout. Custom resources require an unimplemented runtime; this file is not an executable integration.

AwaitDeployment.Comment: Waits for a recorded deployment whose revision matches the verified code snapshot.

Observe.Comment: Reads the production signals named in the service guide for a bounded window.

Evaluate.Comment: Compares captured signals with the outcomes the approved plan expected.

ProposeWorkItem.Comment: Proposes a candidate work item at Intake with the observation evidence. A human decides on rollback.

Regressed.Cause: Production signals contradict the outcomes the approved plan expected.

NeedsAttention.Cause: Required production signals are unavailable or inconclusive.
